parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly made of lightweight plastic, typically circular with multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, converting electrical energy from the motor into mechanical motion to move air efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor, creating a continuous airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the fan, made of durable plastic, providing structural support and housing for the motor and fan assembly.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan blades and motor, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation. It may also contain control buttons or switches.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during operation, serving as the main support structure for the rotating fan blades.
